gloss: critical biography; biographical essay with commentary

definitions.gloss: critical biography; biographical essay with commentary
definitions.explanation: A biography that includes the author's evaluation and criticism of the subject's life and work, rather than simply narrating facts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏目漱石|なつめそうせき}→夏目漱石：30575_natsumesouseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{評伝|ひょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a critical biography of Natsume Soseki.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{評伝|ひょうでん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}いている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: This critical biography carefully depicts the painter's life and works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}す→覆す：07568_kutsugaesu⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{評伝|ひょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{上|あ}げた→書き上げる：06978_kakiageru⟧。
examples.english: Based on years of research, the author produced a new critical biography that overturns previous assessments.

notes:
A compound of {評|ひょう} (critique, evaluation) and {伝|でん} (biography, account). Unlike a straightforward biography (⟦{伝記|でんき}→伝記：04069_denki⟧), a {評伝|ひょうでん} includes the author's critical analysis and assessment of the subject. It is a literary genre particularly common in Japanese publishing.

Often used for biographies of writers, artists, politicians, and other notable figures where the author's interpretive perspective adds depth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {評伝|ひょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a critical biography
- {評伝|ひょうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read a critical biography
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{評伝|ひょうでん}: a critical biography of ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伝記|でんき}→伝記：04069_denki⟧: biography — a factual account of someone's life without critical commentary
- ⟦{自伝|じでん}→自伝：25302_jiden⟧: autobiography — written by the subject themselves
- {列伝|れつでん}: biographical sketches of multiple people — a collection of short biographies
